description: A painted street protest at dusk. A man in a flat cap shouts with a raised fist, holding a blank placard. Behind him a crowd of men in caps and hats and women in cloche hats carry blank placards and banners on poles. On the right a line of uniformed police with batons stands before a large neoclassical stone building with columns and arched windows. Oil-painting style, full-bleed, no visible text or frame.
